Package index

Package

rePredRet rePredRet-package
rePredRet: Retention Time Prediction by Direct System Mapping

User Workflow

Build models from your own retention time data and generate predictions for new systems. This is the primary interface for end users.

build_user_models()
Build Calibration Models from Repository Systems to User's System
predict_rt_user()
Generate RT Predictions from User Models
show(<UserRTModels>) summary(<UserRTModels>) `[[`(<UserRTModels>,<character>) names(<UserRTModels>) length(<UserRTModels>) plot(<UserRTModels>,<missing>)
UserRTModels S4 Class
show(<UserRTPredictions>) summary(<UserRTPredictions>) as.data.frame(<UserRTPredictions>) length(<UserRTPredictions>) `[`(<UserRTPredictions>,<ANY>,<ANY>,<ANY>) plot(<UserRTPredictions>,<missing>)
UserRTPredictions S4 Class
validate_models()
Validate Models with Cross-Validation
check_input_data()
Check Input Data Quality
export_predictions()
Export Predictions to Files
